newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: Azeris see rise in 1998 foreign investment.
newsitem.headline: Azeris see rise in 1998 foreign investment.

text.p: Overall foreign investment in Azerbaijan is expected to rise 6.4 percent in 1998 to $1.48 billion, Deputy Economy Minister Oktay Akhverdiyev said on Thursday.
"We see direct foreign investment rising 25 percent to about $1.35 billion next year," he told Reuters.
He forecast total foreign investment in the oil sector as a percentage of the volume of total foreign investment falling to 69 percent in 1998 from 72 percent in 1997 and 80 percent in 1996.
"We see the fact that investment in the oil sector is falling as a percentage of total foreign investment as a positive tendency in our economy's development," Akhverdiyev said.
He said it showed increasing interest among foreign investors in other sectors of the Azeri economy and added that interest was growing especially in such sectors as transport and construction.
Azerbaijan has signed $18 billion worth of long-term oil development contracts with foreign firms to develop its big offshore Caspian Sea reserves.
